en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town with fields in the foreground, a tree‑lined road with a horse‑drawn carriage at right, and in the distance a cluster of buildings including a church with a tall spire and several castle‑like towers. Printed red text in German appears at the top: one phrase on the left indicating the town, and another on the right describing the view.
